title: Inside A Warehouse Where Thousands Of Robots Pack Groceries
summary: A short Insider Tech look at Ocado's grocery warehouse where thousands of robots on a grid pack orders, communicating over 4G to avoid collisions. It handles around 65,000 orders a week.
why: HN cites it as the standard example of advanced warehouse automation in grocery fulfillment.

quote.text: Check out this automated grocery warehouse, something right out of Factorio
